values.note: Most sites are full-hookup pull-throughs (79). Sites 1-20 and 42-59 are on one-way roads and not recommended for large RVs. Four walk-in tent sites besides.

sites.source: DNR overnight facilities ('The campground has 109 drive-in sites. The majority of sites are pull-through ... Sites 1-20 and 42-59 are on one-way roads. values.note: No dump station: sewer is at the full-hookup sites. Showers and flush toilets are summer-only.

values.note: The DNR says the campground usually opens the first full weekend of May, weather permitting; in 2026 it closed October 26.

note: Sherlock Park Campground in the East Grand Forks Greenway, the land between the Red and Red Lake rivers cleared after the 1997 flood; open, grassy loops with scattered trees, the Greenway trails and the riverwalk shops beside it. --Claude
summary: DNR + ReserveMN read: 109 drive-in (98 full hookup incl. 79 pull-throughs, 3 electric, 8 non-electric) + 4 walk-in; 20/30/50-amp; $24 / $34 / $42 confirmed; 60-ft limit; no dump station (sewer at sites) -> dump true -> false; summer showers; season 2027 Apr 30-Oct 24 (2026 closed Oct 26). Not waterfront kept; pin OK.
